snippets.text: So, I heard you like short, easy to
understand, and straight to the point
guides. Here is the fastest and most
efficient way to reach level 45 as Ilios
explained in under 4 minutes. Recently,
I have done a leveling speedrun with
Ranger on Taiwan servers, and I have
reached level 45 in 3 hours and 40
minutes. You can find the link to the
full uncut video in the description. The
leveling consists of following yellow
main story quest while only doing 12
different regional green side quest. The
reason why you will need to do some side
quest is because to proceed with the
main story, you need to complete the
Ascension quest two times. And to fill
up the Ascension gauge to 100%, you will
need to do five side quest two times
during leveling. Start by following
yellow main story quest from level one
all until you reach level 12, where you
will also pick up and complete the first
green side quest. At level 14 in Marsh
Legion campsite, pick up a second green
side quest, complete it, and deliver it.
Continue with the main story until you
get to level 22. You will get a locked
out with Ascension gauge at a 90.6%
so you will need to complete three side
quests. First, go to Dundus Rest and
complete Sneaky Drakan. Then go to
Valley Outpost and complete Closure, and
then go to Dawn Legion Base and complete
Searching for Escaped Fossa. Complete
the Ascension quest and carry on with
the main story until level 29, where you
will pick up Side Effects of
Transformation quest in this camp and
also complete it. After completing the
Urugugu Canyon and delivering the main
story quest, two green side quests will
appear in the same camp. Grab them,
complete, and deliver because you will
get a Clash Rune as a reward. Keep going
with the main story until you turn in
the quest in Zumion Village at level 32,
where another side quest will appear
next to you. Grab it and complete it.
Straight after, go to Verteron Fortress
Ruins and complete it the side quest,
which will unlock the third ascension.
Complete it and carry on with the main
story until level 36, where you will
also grab the price of bravado side
quest in the same camp. Shortly after
completing a few more main story quest,
another side quest appears in the same
camp. Grab it and complete it. After
that, it's a straight main story push
all the way to level 45, right before
the final boss.
Now, let me give you some tips. Before
leveling, you'll want to make sure you
keybind your macro key to whatever you
like and set up your macro as soon as
you unlock all of your skills. Having
macro while leveling makes every boss
fight easier. Whenever you are moving
from quest to quest, always use a wing
flying tweak to travel faster and not to
waste flight power. You don't need to
enhance your gear, but you can if you
get stuck. It won't give you much power
and you will replace it anyways.
up your most important damage dealing
skills first and always replace the
better gear item when you get it from
the quest. It's indicated by this green
arrow that you have something better in
your inventory. If you don't want to do
these side quests, you can do sealed
dungeons, but the main reason why I do
side quests is because you get
accessories as a reward, which you don't
get from the main story quest. And
accessories will increase your power
significantly, making bosses and mobs
easier to kill. Grab all the feathers
that are in your way or close to the
area where you are, but do not go out of
your way to grab them. And also, don't
forget about your stigma skills. After
you unlock at with the ascension, every
time you level up, you get one stigma
point. So, always make sure you are
leveling them up and using the best ones
that you can. And that's going to be it.
Since I helped you level up to 45,
consider helping me out by interacting
with this video, subscribing and leaving
a like.
If you are interested in more content,
check out videos appearing on your
screen.
